other_conditions: The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand
The applicant must be engaged in any building or construction work
The applicant must be registered under the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers’ Welfare Board
The applicant must have an active membership of the Board
Eligibility for benefits begins only after three months from registration
The benefit can be received only once in the applicant’s lifetime
The applicant must not have received the same benefit from any other scheme
The applicant must have worked as a construction worker for at least 90 days during the preceding one year
benefits_summary: A free umbrella is provided to eligible construction workers, with no financial assistance.
